integrity: The asserted sharpness and classification are proved analytically using a matrix-valued Fourier multiplier. The deterministic finite checks support but do not replace the proof. Originality is subject to possible historical weighted-shift formulations.
limitations: The theorem is for bilateral two-periodic first-order scalar recurrences in the Hilbert-energy norm; it does not give one-sided sup-norm Ulam constants, longer-period formulas, or independent literature certification.
title: Sharp energy-norm stability for two-periodic recurrences
